id: 36_Tricky Safety MCQs for Safety Professionals Logical HSE Questions with Answers S
title: 安全陷阱十问
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/36_Tricky Safety MCQs for Safety Professionals Logical HSE Questions with Answers S.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/36_Tricky Safety MCQs for Safety Professionals Logical HSE Questions with Answers S/src.py

points.K2: 穿了安全带还要看挂点
points.K3: 小房间用二氧化碳会缺氧
points.K4: 测过气，作业中还要复测
points.K9: 干净不等于安全：线缆绊人
points.K11: 明知故犯是不安全行为

shots.scene: 欣欣托着下巴思考，头顶问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot rubs its chin thoughtfully with question marks floating above its head, then waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 看起来安全，真的安全吗？

shots.scene: 阿杰自信地举起答题卡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student confidently holds up a blank quiz card.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：这些题，一看就会。

shots.scene: 小研笑着摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研说：小心，每题都有陷阱。

shots.scene: 一扇门上写着“安全”的空白牌，门后是坑
shots.prompt_en: A door with a blank green sign; behind the door, a hidden hole in the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 表面条件满足，不等于真的安全。

shots.section_title: 穿了安全带还要看挂点
shots.scene: 老李穿着安全带，挂钩挂在一根细管子上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a full body harness, its hook clipped to a thin pipe.
shots.narration: 第一题：穿了安全带就完全安全？
overlay: 穿了安全带还要看挂点

shots.section_title: 穿了安全带还要看挂点
shots.scene: 细管子打叉，结实的挂点圈出
shots.prompt_en: The thin pipe is crossed out; a sturdy anchor point on a steel beam is circled. No people.
shots.narration: 不，挂点也要牢靠。

shots.section_title: 穿了安全带还要看挂点
shots.scene: 安全帽、手套图标旁打问号
shots.prompt_en: A hard hat icon and a glove icon with question marks beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 戴没戴安全帽手套，不是关键。

shots.section_title: 小房间用二氧化碳会缺氧
shots.scene: 小房间里电器冒烟，有人拿二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: In a small closed room, a carbon dioxide extinguisher nozzle is aimed at a smoking electrical device. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：小房间用二氧化碳灭火器？
overlay: 小房间用二氧化碳会缺氧

shots.section_title: 小房间用二氧化碳会缺氧
shots.scene: 氧气分子被挤出房间的示意
shots.prompt_en: Oxygen molecule icons being pushed out of a small room by gas clouds. No people.
shots.narration: 隐藏危害：氧气被挤走，会窒息。

shots.section_title: 小房间用二氧化碳会缺氧
shots.scene: 小研灭火后撤出，开门通风
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steps out of the small room after using the extinguisher and props the door open for ventilation.
shots.narration: 用完马上撤出，通风后再进。

shots.section_title: 测过气，作业中还要复测
shots.scene: 老李在检修口外用检测仪测气
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests the air at an open hatch with a gas detector.
shots.narration: 第三题：进有限空间前测过气就行？
overlay: 测过气，作业中还要复测

shots.section_title: 测过气，作业中还要复测
shots.scene: 时间线上气体浓度曲线突然升高
shots.prompt_en: A timeline graph where a gas level line suddenly rises during work. No people.
shots.narration: 不，作业中气体会变，要复测。

shots.section_title: 测过气，作业中还要复测
shots.scene: 风扇图标旁打问号
shots.prompt_en: A fan icon with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 开着通风，也不能省掉检测。

shots.scene: 仪器电源线外皮开裂，但看不到铜线
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory instrument power cord with cracked outer insulation, no copper visible. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：绝缘破了没露线，能凑合用吗？

shots.scene: 戴手套、低电压、天晴三个图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A glove icon, a low-voltage icon and a sun icon, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不能，戴手套、天干燥都不是理由。

shots.scene: 老李拔下插头，换上新电线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unplugs the instrument and replaces the damaged cord with a new one.
shots.narration: 停用、报修、更换，别缠胶布。

shots.scene: 校园里一条很浅的沟
shots.prompt_en: A very shallow trench dug across a campus path. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：沟很浅，还要安全措施吗？

shots.scene: 沟边塌落和地下管线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a crumbling trench edge and an underground pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 要，塌方、碰管线和深浅无关。

shots.scene: 沟边围挡和警示牌
shots.prompt_en: Barriers and a warning sign set up around the shallow trench. No people.
shots.narration: 围挡、警示、查管线，一样不少。

shots.scene: 老李戴安全帽却没系下颏带，帽子歪着
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a hard hat with the chin strap hanging loose; the hat tilts.
shots.narration: 第六题：防护用品戴全了还受伤？

shots.scene: 颜色、品牌图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A color palette icon and a brand tag icon, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 多半是不合适，或者没用对。

shots.scene: 老李系好下颏带
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fastens the chin strap of his hard hat.
shots.narration: 选对型号，按要求正确佩戴。

shots.scene: 起重机吊着箱子，风向标狂转
shots.prompt_en: A crane lifts a crate while a wind vane spins wildly. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：没超载，风大还能吊吗？

shots.scene: 吊物在风中摆动
shots.prompt_en: The suspended crate swings sideways in strong wind lines. No people.
shots.narration: 不能，风会让吊物晃动失稳。

shots.scene: 指挥人员示意停止，吊物落地
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer signals stop with raised hands; the crate is lowered to the ground.
shots.narration: 按说明书规定，风大就停。

shots.section_title: 干净不等于安全：线缆绊人
shots.scene: 实验室干净整洁，但过道上散着电线
shots.prompt_en: A clean and tidy laboratory, but loose cables lie across the aisle. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：地面干净，线缆横在过道？
overlay: 干净不等于安全：线缆绊人

shots.section_title: 干净不等于安全：线缆绊人
shots.scene: 人形被线绊倒的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person tripping over a cable. No people.
shots.narration: 照样会绊人，不安全。

shots.section_title: 干净不等于安全：线缆绊人
shots.scene: 线缆收进线槽，过道照明充足
shots.prompt_en: Cables tucked into a floor cable cover; the aisle is brightly lit. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆要收好，过道要亮。

shots.scene: 老李给离心机电源上锁挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer locks out the power switch of a centrifuge and hangs a blank tag.
shots.narration: 第九题：上锁后，马上开修？

shots.scene: 老李按启动键确认不动，用测电笔测试
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the start button to confirm nothing moves, then checks with a voltage tester.
shots.narration: 先验证零能量，确认没有残余能量。

shots.scene: 摘牌、直接开修图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of removing a tag and an icon of starting repair immediately, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不能摘牌，也不能直接动手。

shots.section_title: 明知故犯是不安全行为
shots.scene: 阿杰为了快，跳过了戴护目镜那一步
shots.prompt_en: The young male student skips putting on goggles to save time, reaching for a bottle.
shots.narration: 第十题：明知规程却图省事？
overlay: 明知故犯是不安全行为

shots.section_title: 明知故犯是不安全行为
shots.scene: 缺防护、照明差、设备坏图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of missing gear, a dim bulb and a broken machine, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 真正的问题是不安全行为。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着钟表，手忙脚乱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rushes at the bench while glancing anxiously at a wall clock.
shots.narration: 图省事，往往因为赶时间。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰一起排实验计划，留出空档
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student plan experiments on a blank schedule, leaving gaps between tasks.
shots.narration: 实验计划留余量，不靠抢时间。

shots.scene: 阿杰停下来深呼吸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pauses and takes a deep breath before continuing.
shots.narration: 一着急，就先停一停。

shots.scene: 几种手套并排：乳胶、丁腈、厚橡胶
shots.prompt_en: Several pairs of gloves side by side in different colors and thicknesses. No people.
shots.narration: 手套不是随便戴一双就行。

shots.scene: 小研对照说明书选手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank data sheet and picks a matching pair of gloves.
shots.narration: 按化学品查说明书，选合适材质。

shots.scene: 手套破洞的图标，扔进废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A glove with a small hole is discarded into a waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 有破损、被污染，马上更换。

shots.scene: 阿杰一手拎着两个大试剂瓶的瓶颈
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries two large reagent bottles by their necks in one hand, wrist strained.
shots.narration: 单手拎瓶颈，手腕受累还易摔。

shots.scene: 阿杰改用提篮，双手提着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries the bottles in a bottle carrier with both hands, wrists straight.
shots.narration: 用托盘或提篮，双手平稳拿。

shots.scene: 推车上放着防漏托盘
shots.prompt_en: A cart with a spill tray holding several reagent bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶多就用推车，路上不慌。

shots.scene: 一排图标：挂点、氧气、检测仪、电线、锁
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: an anchor point, an oxygen symbol, a gas detector, a power cord and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 挂点、缺氧、复测、破线、验零能量。

shots.scene: 阿杰收起答题卡，认真点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts away the quiz card and nods seriously.
shots.narration: 看似安全时，多问一句为什么。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with a knowing smile.
shots.narration: 多想一步，避开陷阱！
